_comment: Heat (after each milestone boss): the team votes on one of the offered heat cards, or Skip. Cards stay for the rest of the run (heat only goes up). Each point of heat: +scrapPerHeat % haul Scrap and +luckPerHeat gear and shop luck, up to maxRewardHeat. Card ids that match a difficulty modifier switch that modifier on (elite_swarm, glass_cannon, thin_wallets, fragile_goods, iron_bodies, short_fuse, blackout); monster_surge, hardened_bosses and lean_shop are heat-only.

cards.name: Blackout
cards.desc: no threat labels, scan markers or Watchpost pings

cards.name: Hardened Bosses
cards.desc: bosses get one more modifier and 25% more health

cards.name: Glass Cannon
cards.desc: everyone takes 30% more damage (and deals 30% more)

cards.name: Fragile Goods
cards.desc: valuables take 25% more damage when hit

cards.name: Iron Bodies
cards.desc: no healing from abilities or gear, regeneration off

cards.name: Thin Wallets
cards.desc: half the Scrap from the haul
